# BLO-32734 phase 2b — overlay the PVC root, re-expose only the toolchain read-only

`src/server/job-manifest.ts`: on a narrowed run (`narrowWritableSurface`), the
`data` volume is no longer mounted read-only at `dataMountPath`. A per-pod
`root-overlay` `emptyDir` takes that path instead, followed by read-only
`subPath` binds of `ROOT_TOOLCHAIN_SUBPATHS` (`bin`, `tools`, `jre`,
`.local/bin`, `.bun/bin`, `.cache/puppeteer-browsers`). The phase-2a instance
overlay and every scoped rw bind stack on top unchanged; both containers share
one `rootMounts` list, so the BLO-40401 ordering holds in each. The toolchain
subPaths join `scopedWritableDirs`, so a dir missing on some deployment is
pre-created by the server rather than by the kubelet as `root:root`.

Why: the PVC root is the server's `node` home. Through the read-only parent,
every narrowed pod could still read `.ssh`, `.kube`, `.secrets`,
`.claude/.credentials.json`, mkcert's CA key under `.local/share`, and every
tenant's `wt-*` worktrees. The allowlist was measured from a narrowed pod:
HOME, XDG_* and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR are per-run, and the only root references
are PATH (`.local/bin`, `bin`) plus the symlink targets inside those two dirs.

Broad (non-narrowed) runs are unchanged. `src/server/job-manifest.test.ts`:
three parent-mount assertions now expect `root-overlay`; one new case pins the
root secrets and a foreign worktree to the overlay and the toolchain to
read-only `data`. Mutation-checked: reverting the overlay fails 7 cases;
dropping `.local/bin` from the allowlist fails 1.
